title: Screen Recognition Tool — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Identifies visible text, controls, icons, and interface elements. The Screen Recognition Tool looks at a screenshot and identifies what is on screen: text via OCR, buttons, text fields, icons, and window controls with their bounding boxes. It returns a structured element list that the mouse and keyboard tools can target by name instead of raw coordinates.
capabilities: OCR text extraction with bounding boxes
Button, field, checkbox, and menu detection
Icon matching against a template library
Element list with names, roles, and coordinates
Confidence score per detected element
